WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS copies
  FROM inventory AS i
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
rating_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(copies) AS avg_copies
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT
  SUM(rc.copies) AS total_films_in_stock,
  AVG(rc.copies - ra.avg_copies) AS avg_excess_copies
FROM rating_counts AS rc
CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra
WHERE rc.copies > ra.avg_copies

WITH rating_stock AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS copies
  FROM inventory AS i
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
rating_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(copies) AS mean_copies
  FROM rating_stock
)
SELECT
  SUM(rs.copies) AS total_films_in_stock,
  AVG((rs.copies - ra.mean_copies) * 100.0 / ra.mean_copies) AS average_excess_percentage
FROM rating_stock AS rs
CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra
WHERE rs.copies > ra.mean_copies

WITH titles_by_rating AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS stocked_titles
  FROM film AS f
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
rating_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(stocked_titles) AS avg_titles
  FROM titles_by_rating
)
SELECT
  SUM(t.stocked_titles) AS total_films_in_stock,
  AVG(t.stocked_titles - a.avg_titles) AS avg_excess_titles
FROM titles_by_rating AS t
CROSS JOIN rating_average AS a
WHERE t.stocked_titles > a.avg_titles

WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT i.film_id) AS stocked_films
  FROM inventory AS i
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
rating_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(stocked_films) AS mean_films
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT
  SUM(rc.stocked_films) AS total_films_in_stock,
  AVG((rc.stocked_films - ra.mean_films) * 100.0 / ra.mean_films) AS average_excess_percent
FROM rating_counts AS rc
CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra
WHERE rc.stocked_films > ra.mean_films
